lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: The Legion has reached our fields. You're going to fight, aren't you?

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: I know. I just wish that someone didn't have to be you. Come here. That strap won't last a minute.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: Being scared means you're paying attention. Let me fix your strap. Then promise me you'll come back when you need help.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: Try standing behind the fence. Makes you look taller. Hold still while I fix this strap.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: Go to Mara. She needs help treating the wounded. I'll help our neighbors pack.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I need tangle roots for fevers and clean dressings for wounds. Help me get these people ready to leave.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The wounded need treatment before they can fight or escape.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Only if it comes wrapped in clean cloth. And please don't bring it inside.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Bring three tangle roots from the garden and clean dressings from the village store. Its front door is open.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Three roots from the garden. Clean dressings from the store.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Thank you. The neighbors can rest now. I found this purple crystal in the fields—take it from my supply table. It may help on your journey. Next, clear the mill crossing.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Follow the road to the mill. Its pressure plate shuts the water feed. Keep it down while you free the jammed wheel.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: My tools are in the loft. I can't climb up while the Legion is outside.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: These are my neighbors. I'm staying to help.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Bring my tool roll from the loft window. I'll open the workshop shortcut and give you a purple shard.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: The tool roll is by the loft window.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Thanks. Take this shard. The workshop shortcut is open if the street gets dangerous.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Door's open. Watch the low beam. It has won every argument I've had with it.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: I'm scared. They knocked our village sign into the mud. Please don't make this worse.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: All right. Give me a moment. Seeing our village name in the dirt hurt.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: You fixed the sign. Thank you. Fetch my tools and I'll help with the door.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Go. I'll find someone else to help. I've got enough trouble outside my door.

lines.speaker: lewis
lines.text: Their signal post is ahead. Silence the horn before it brings patrols to our neighbors.

lines.speaker: lewis
lines.text: Go through the camp or climb the roots on the right. Stop the crank below the horn, or cut its cable from above.

lines.speaker: lewis
lines.text: They took prisoners north toward Hollow Pass. The guards know their names, but show no mercy.

lines.speaker: lewis
lines.text: Silence the horn, then reach the north clearing. I'll watch the neighbors.

lines.speaker: lewis
lines.text: The horn is quiet. Our neighbors are safe here, but something large blocks the way ahead.

lines.speaker: beth
lines.text: My brother followed our sheep across the bridge. It broke. He's trapped beyond those beasts.

lines.speaker: beth
lines.text: Those sheep are our food and wool. He was trying to save them.

lines.speaker: beth
lines.text: Follow his crooked heel prints east. Cross the remaining bridge beams; there's a lower dry path if you slip.

lines.speaker: beth
lines.text: He's safe! Once we leave the woods, our dog can travel with you.

lines.speaker: bethBrother
lines.text: The fallen tree could roll. Clear the beasts, then use the rope lift to raise it.

lines.speaker: bethBrother
lines.text: I can walk once the path is clear.

lines.speaker: bethBrother
lines.text: The tree's up and the crossing is fixed. I'm heading back. Thank you.

lines.speaker: grant
lines.text: Clear the arrow post, cut its bow cord, then raise the gate. People are trapped beyond it and in the cells below.

lines.speaker: grant
lines.text: The Legion seized ordinary workers. Help me get them out.

lines.speaker: grant
lines.text: Ring the breach bell when ready. Stay nearby and defend either gap until everyone crosses. If we retreat, we can try again.

lines.speaker: grant
lines.text: After the rescue, take the lower guard post's jail key or climb east and turn the gate wheel. Either opens the stairs.

lines.speaker: grant
lines.text: Everyone is safe. Search the cells below. The Legion's prisoner records may tell you where the missing people went.

lines.speaker: felix
lines.text: Recover my tools from the east workshop. I'll open the west chamber and give you a dagger.

lines.speaker: felix
lines.text: Watch the latch's notch. Press when it turns green.

lines.speaker: felix
lines.text: The west chamber holds a shield and armed figures. The broken western wall may offer another entrance.

lines.speaker: felix
lines.text: Tools returned. The west chamber is open. Take this dagger—the Lockpick.

lines.speaker: felix
lines.text: Watch the chamber's guards. Give yourself room if they wake.

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: Stop. You need a disguise to get through that guarded door.

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: Bring a supply coat, a sound helmet and crew papers. I'll fit the disguise. You'll still need convincing answers.

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: The disguise covers your gear. Keep your answers short when Cross questions you.

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: Cross the broken drain below the bell post. The brake lowers a walkway back. Then turn the bridge wheel by the bell post.

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: My chest piece is in the seized goods room, east of the wagon yard. Return it for a reward.

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: They already tried that voice on me. Do you want to try a different one?

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: I'll still fit your disguise. But we're done discussing my armor.

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: Keep it, then. You get no reward for returning it. The disguise is a separate matter.

lines.speaker: roland
lines.text: My name is still stamped inside. Thank you. Take this shard from the palace shipment.

lines.speaker: cross
lines.text: State your crew.

lines.speaker: cross
lines.text: That does not match this delivery. Present the crew papers. One more answer.

lines.speaker: cross
lines.text: When does this crew enter?

lines.speaker: cross
lines.text: Papers accepted. Keep the passage clear. Do not leave the assigned route.

lines.speaker: cross
lines.text: Move along.

lines.speaker: cross
lines.text: False orders. Hold the court. No one passes.

lines.speaker: cross
lines.text: Guard. Advance.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: They caught me and were taking me to the Gate. My sealed notes fell near the west tunnel. Read them when you find the pack.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: I helped with the King's research. My notes show where the Legion gets its weapons.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: Brown pack, red seal. Look on the low shelf west of this room.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: We wanted to stop aging and disease. That was the work I agreed to.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: The Gate stopped aging. But those who returned obeyed every order he gave. We should have stopped the research then.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: I ignored the warnings. Then my colleagues began obeying him too. I ran. Let me help now.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: Emberdeep arms the Legion. Shut its forge down. Three officers guard this cavern's north exit.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: I don't know how to restore them. Remember: they were people before they were his soldiers.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: The water lifts an old platform. Pump it up to the middle marks, jump over to freeze the channel, then reach the drain on the far bank.

lines.speaker: ellis
lines.text: I'll gather my research. It's time I helped instead of hiding.

lines.speaker: hugo
lines.text: I fell through the ice. Can you help me out?

lines.speaker: hugo
lines.text: Yes, I saw the warning sign. You can laugh once I'm out.

lines.speaker: hugo
lines.text: Find spare rope on the lower eastern path. Secure the wooden frame before lowering it.

lines.speaker: hugo
lines.text: There's a sealed chamber below the waterworks and a high ledge above the frozen waterfall.

lines.speaker: hugo
lines.text: Take this shard. For the side chamber, drain the old water first. Check the plate by the controls.

lines.speaker: hugo
lines.text: I'll wait safely by the waterworks. Somewhere without thin ice.

lines.speaker: hugo
lines.text: Both boots on solid ground. I could get used to this.

lines.speaker: hugo
lines.text: The chamber is west, below the waterworks. Drain first and follow the marks. The waterfall ledge is east.

lines.speaker: abyss_king
lines.text: Every healer fights death. I found an answer. You came to destroy it.

lines.speaker: abyss_king
lines.text: They will never grow old. You offer them death and call it mercy.

lines.speaker: abyss_king
lines.text: Ian is dead. There has been no Bladeborn since him. How can you stand against me?

lines.speaker: abyss_king
lines.text: Then I will take all the Void's power. I will not lose Aerth to you.

lines.speaker: ian
lines.text: You fought before you knew you could win. I've been waiting to meet you.

lines.speaker: ian
lines.text: I'm Ian's spirit. My life ended peacefully. Yours is beginning. You are Bladeborn.

lines.speaker: ian
lines.text: Your blood carries an old Bladeborn line. Thomas found you orphaned and raised you as his own. Your courage was always yours.

lines.speaker: ian
lines.text: Of course Thomas is your father. He raised you, loved you, and helped you become yourself.

lines.speaker: ian
lines.text: The King's control is gone. The binding still traps the souls. We must break it from inside.

lines.speaker: ian
lines.text: Take my blade. Put all your strength into one cut through the binding. Free them.

lines.speaker: ian
lines.text: The souls are returning. Even those whose bodies fell are whole again. You gave them their lives back.

lines.speaker: ian
lines.text: One day you'll join the Bladeborn spirits. We learn together and watch over Aerth. For now, go home. Your life awaits.

lines.speaker: pike
lines.text: Production is interrupted. State your work station and reason for entry. Workers without a task return to the line.

lines.speaker: pike
lines.text: West maintenance bay. All faults must be checked against the shift schedule. Unsupported claims delay production.

lines.speaker: pike
lines.text: Your delay has been noted.

lines.speaker: pike
lines.text: Pressure loss confirmed. Inspection takes priority. Gate patrol: examine the west pipe. Worker passage is cleared for maintenance.

lines.speaker: pike
lines.text: Unassigned movement. Gate patrol: stop this worker. Production must continue.

lines.speaker: pike
lines.text: The schedule does not allow further discussion.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: The weapon line has stopped. Help me get the workers out.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: Open the worker passage. I can lead everyone to the break room, but guards will come. Stop the transport chain first if you want fewer patrols on the route.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: Open the west passage, then ring the work bell. Stay with us and keep the guards off the workers.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: Stop the transport chain on the west loading floor. Then ring the work bell and guard us on the way up.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: I am keeping count. Every worker, every time. What have you found?

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: Stand on the blue cooling pedal. Water flows while you hold it, so watch the gauge and fight from there. Cold water may also weaken the Colossus's heated armor.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: The Legion locks seized papers above the east gallery. Search there.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: Sunspire Palace has an orb that answers one question. My Storm Coast contacts can help you reach it once we escape.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: You stopped their weapons and rescued us. We'll help you reach Sunspire.

lines.speaker: martin
lines.text: The heat is hurting that creature. Shut its feed at the cage bay. The skitters will come running; clear them, then open the lock.

lines.speaker: caleb
lines.text: I escaped a prisoner wagon. Ruth stayed with the others. Please help me get them out.

lines.speaker: caleb
lines.text: I ran. Now I want to help. I can show you the wagon.

lines.speaker: caleb
lines.text: Take the lower path past the split rocks. Follow my cloth markers to the wagon below the tall stone arch.

lines.speaker: caleb
lines.text: Lower the freight bridge. Reach the lookout by fighting or using the high shelves. Its lift leads to the canyon cages.

lines.speaker: caleb
lines.text: Ruth kept everyone alive. She'll know which prisoners need help.

lines.speaker: caleb
lines.text: They're headed for Ruined Keep. Free them before the next escort leaves. I'll wait for anyone escaping.

lines.speaker: skip
lines.text: I'm Skip. I climb these cliffs. Watch the edge.

lines.speaker: skip
lines.text: Recover my rope below the broken eastern platform. Use the lower shelf. I'll fix the ridge crossing and give you a spear.

lines.speaker: skip
lines.text: The spear's never fallen off a cliff. Better record than mine.

lines.speaker: skip
lines.text: Drooping cloth means calmer wind. Close the windbreak below to shelter the upper crossing. Look for a purple glint on the ridge.

lines.speaker: skip
lines.text: The ridge crossing is ready. Take Cliff Runner, as promised.

lines.speaker: skip
lines.text: The bridge cart sits on the left rail. Roll it onto the floor plate, then release the bridge winch.

lines.speaker: skip
lines.text: I watched the bridge move when the cart hit that plate. Keep clear of the wheels.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: I sell equipment and buy spare gear. What do you need?

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: Compare gear before buying. Check class and level requirements. Sell spares you no longer need.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: I equip the people who can fight. That's how I help.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: Your victories are giving people hope.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Bring spare gear. I'll forge something stronger.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Fuse two matching items of the same rarity. Check the result first: both original items are consumed.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: I used to make hinges. I'd like to do that again.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: People are repairing their homes instead of fleeing. Keep giving them hope.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Choose how you want to look. The wardrobe is ready.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Choose unlocked cosmetics in the wardrobe. Appearance changes do not increase your strength.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Looking like yourself can help you feel like yourself again.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: Hope suits the people you've helped.

lines.speaker: drillmaster
lines.text: Choose a class, learn its skills, then practice.

lines.speaker: drillmaster
lines.text: Equip unlocked classes here. New disciplines may require trials. Test your skills in the Sparring Room.

lines.speaker: drillmaster
lines.text: You don't need to be fearless. Pay attention and keep practicing.

lines.speaker: drillmaster
lines.text: The next enemy may fight differently. Keep learning.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: Looking for a companion? Mind your fingers around the hungry ones.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: Equip one owned companion in the Pet Yard. Check its abilities, name it, and train it to suit your play style.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: Even a small companion can make a big difference.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: The animals knew you were back before I did.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: The freed prisoners are reaching us. We have more people to feed—and more hands to help.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: The forge is quiet. Now we need tools and roof nails instead of swords.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: People we thought lost are coming home. I've borrowed another table.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: A freed prisoner asked for a door latch. It's good to build something ordinary again.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: You stopped their forge. Let's use what's left to rebuild.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Windows, gates, cooking pots. Finally, repairs without Legion orders.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: The freed prisoners wanted clothes they chose themselves.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: A worker kept a scrap of colored cloth to remember home. I'll mend it for him.

lines.speaker: keeper
lines.text: What should free people wear? Whatever they like.

lines.speaker: drillmaster
lines.text: Three more people want training. Yesterday, they wanted somewhere to hide.

lines.speaker: drillmaster
lines.text: The Legion can replace a sword more easily than its forge. Well done.

lines.speaker: drillmaster
lines.text: Peace needs protecting. Keep practicing—but take today off.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: A freed prisoner called his dog's name. It recognized him at once.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: Less smoke from Emberdeep helps the animals too.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: The restored animals are recognizing their families. Give them time.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: This forge arms the Legion. Free the workers beside the hammer before touching any valves.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: Clear the guards and open the shelter first. Sabotaging loaded machinery could hurt the workers.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: Open the shelter west of the workers. Find Jack by the service cart beyond. Take the patrol route or the high walkway.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: Recover my blade blank from the raised store east of the presses. I'll make you a reward.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: Choose a weapon or armor when you return it.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: I'll stay here. Find me when you're ready.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: Shelter the workers, then repair Jack's cart. In the machine room, push the scrap sled along the track. The floor flashes before the hammer falls. Jam the drive gear to stop the line.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: You found it. Take this shard too. Now choose what I should forge.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: Take Forgeguard. Finish Iron Halls to secure what you've earned.

lines.speaker: flint
lines.text: The line is stopped. Find Martin and the other workers in the Great Furnace.

lines.speaker: jack
lines.text: The western stores have insulated brake handles. Fit them to this cart, or bring them to me. Then its deck can bridge the gap.

lines.speaker: jack
lines.text: Exactly. Very reliable at that part. I’m trying to expand its range.

lines.speaker: jack
lines.text: Western stores. Look for thick wrapped grips. Fit them into the cart or bring them to me.

lines.speaker: jack
lines.text: The floor lights up before each press falls. Cross after it strikes, or take the lower patrol route.

lines.speaker: jack
lines.text: Push the scrap sled from behind. When the hammer warns, stop and let it strike, then push on. The sled jams the drive gear.

lines.speaker: jack
lines.text: The cart bridge is ready. Stop the weapon line before crossing. Then the western casting molds will be cool enough to open.

lines.speaker: jack
lines.text: I'll keep the route clear. You handle the Great Furnace.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: Quiet. The guards count footsteps now. I told them the stairs would win.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: The King is above. My friends are in the cells below him. Please free them.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: Release the catches on the first and second great turns. They stay open.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: Clear the guards on the next turn and pull the cell wheel. I'll lead the prisoners through the service passage.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: They're free. I'll guide them out.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: We'll help rebuild your village. You've given us a future.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: The worker-cell lock holds the vault cable. Free them, then climb the broken shelves above the linen room to reach its brake.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: They do not sleep. Somehow they still need bedrooms cleaned.

lines.speaker: miles
lines.text: Keep climbing, then. If you change your mind, the cell wheel is still there.

lines.speaker: ward
lines.text: Holding yard. No visitors. State your work detail.

lines.speaker: ward
lines.text: Orders decide who passes. Check the records desk west of here.

lines.speaker: ward
lines.text: Families may request transport together. All names must be entered in the record.

lines.speaker: ward
lines.text: Fourth cart. West yard. Shift change. Order matches. The work detail will use the other stairs. Proceed.

lines.speaker: ward
lines.text: Your assigned path is open. Do not delay the next transport.

lines.speaker: ward
lines.text: No personal orders were received. False authority. Guards: seize the speaker.

lines.speaker: ward
lines.text: Remain where you are. The gate is closed.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: Caleb escaped? Good. Free both cage groups and cut the alarm cable above the east yard. We need both done to escape.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: You need the gates open to reach the north crossing. Help with those; I'll help the people.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: Cut the east scaffold's alarm cable to stop patrols. Free both groups; protect the north pair as they walk. Then open the escape gate beyond the shelter.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: More prisoners are in the old cage on the west shelf. Please rescue them too.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: A prisoner needs water. Fill these flasks at the clean spring beyond the loaded wagon.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: Thank you. He needed that water badly.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: Everyone's free. Take this Rift Shard as thanks.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: We'll wait under cover until the crossing is safe.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: A Hollowed marksman guards the last crossing. Use cover and alternate paths. Beyond it, follow the records to Ruined Keep.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: The Legion holds the palace. Watch the broken tiles.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: The orb is beyond the Sky Library's locked doors. Help secure the courtyard first.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: Go down the west steps. Remove the iron clamp, then turn the water wheel.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: The wheel supplies our healing station. Open it so we can help the wounded.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: West steps: clamp, then wheel. Afterward, find Victor on the next terrace.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: This large healing pad won't run out. Smaller pads along the paths have limited healing.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: Find Victor beyond the fountain. He knows the guarded balconies.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: Open the east greenhouse's water channel, then bring me the seed tin. We'll grow food again.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: Food still matters during an invasion. You can decline without mocking us.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: Clear the garden channel and bring the seed tin.

lines.speaker: grace
lines.text: Take this Rift Shard and seeds for home. Thank you.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Sergeant Victor. I'm holding what's left of the courtyard watch.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: The workers are safe. The Legion seized the palace for its knowledge.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Either balcony reaches the mirrors. Fight its patrol and pull the upper release, or use the lower garden to drain its lock. The other route is optional.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: You came to help when everyone else was leaving. I'll keep your way back clear.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Aim each of the three mirrors at its sun mark. All three beams must connect to open the door.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: I'll hold the fountain. If one route fails, try the other.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Go find how to stop the King. We'll hold the courtyard.

lines.speaker: walter
lines.text: Search the west cells. The beds are empty, but the guards are still here. Look behind those rooms.

lines.speaker: walter
lines.text: Follow the old service marks behind the empty cells. They lead through a false wall.

lines.speaker: walter
lines.text: Free the prisoners, then grip the winch handle on the lift. Walk around its drum to raise everyone. The old stairs have collapsed. The lift keeps running after they reach shelter.

lines.speaker: walter
lines.text: Ellis helped with the King's research. He escaped to Frostfell. Find him; he may know how to stop this.

lines.speaker: walter
lines.text: I don't know more. Ellis knows the experiments better than I do.

lines.speaker: walter
lines.text: The Fallen guards the release hall. A champion, now Hollowed. We'll wait in the upper shelter until you defeat it.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: I'm Sly. Before we leave, help me return something I stole.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: Walter knows the way out. Speak to him first.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: I stole a family locket and purple shard from a man in the hidden cells. I hoped to buy my escape.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: Once he's free, return the locket to his bundle. I'll help carry his things out.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: Return it to his bundle. I'll confess and let him decide what I owe.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: He keeps reaching for his missing locket. I hoped you'd help me put this right.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: You returned it. I'll confess. Take the shard somewhere useful.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: Here's the shard. I helped him onto the lift. He thanked me. I wish he knew why that hurt.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: He knows. He made me carry his pack, then shared his bread. Take this shard.

lines.speaker: sly
lines.text: I'll stay with the others. No more stealing.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Recover the Legion's tool-head pattern from the western stores. We need good tools to rebuild homes.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: This can wait. Come back when you're ready.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Find the pattern box in the western stores, Iron Halls. Its plate offers a clue. Reach the Great Furnace before returning with the pattern.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Cool the pattern box in Iron Halls' western stores. Finish that half, then return here.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: That's the pattern. Now we can make better tools.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: The new tools are beside the forge. Here's 450 gold.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: Recover food from Broken Walls' sealed western chamber. Our neighbors need it.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: This can wait. Come back when you're ready.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: Climb to the hoist brake in Broken Walls' western chamber. Lower the food, then bring it back here.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: Free the hoist brake above the western chamber. Collect the food below, then bring it here.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: The supplies arrived safely. Thank you.

lines.speaker: quartermaster
lines.text: The shelves are stocked. Here's 300 gold.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: Paw prints lead west from Black Woods' old grove. Check the abandoned traps and rescue both animals.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: They're off the main path. Help when you can safely return.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: Follow both trails west of the grove: low logs and roots. Free both animals, finish Black Woods, then return.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: Follow four-toed paw prints, not split hooves. Check the roots and raised cage. Your own companion isn't required.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: Both animals are free. I'll prepare their shelter and improve our companion care.

lines.speaker: beastkeeper
lines.text: The care shelter is ready. All equipped companions now gain 10% maximum health.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: If you return home, find the little wooden bird you carved. I'd like something of ours here.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: It can wait. I want you safe more than I want the bird.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: Look behind our old house, southwest of the village yard—somewhere sheltered from rain. Finish Homefields before returning.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: Behind our old house, southwest of the yard. Remember that awkward plant pot?

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: Still crooked. Still my favorite bird. Thank you.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: A little piece of home. Take these coins. When this is over, carve me another.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: I'm worried, and I'm proud. You brought people home. Both feelings can be true.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: I'll mend what I can and feed the new arrivals. You're not the only stubborn one here.

lines.speaker: thomas
lines.text: People tell me how you helped them. That's the part of every story I believe.

lines.speaker: riftkeeper
lines.text: Five matching saved shards automatically open a training rift. Briar Town is first on your right; the others follow campaign order.

lines.speaker: riftkeeper
lines.text: Each frame shows its region, class, and saved shard count. What would you like to know?

lines.speaker: riftkeeper
lines.text: Save all five matching shards to open a portal automatically. Necromancer also requires completing Castle Duskmoor. You never need my help to assemble it.

lines.speaker: riftkeeper
lines.text: A Sunspire scholar threw the training rifts from the palace to save them from the Legion. They shattered across Aerth.

lines.speaker: riftkeeper
lines.text: Scattered shards could be recovered. In the Legion's hands, those fighting lessons would be lost.

lines.speaker: riftkeeper
lines.text: A mentor waits inside each rift. Complete the trial to unlock that fighting style.

lines.speaker: riftkeeper
lines.text: These purple rifts lead to training. The King's black Hollow Gate removes souls. They are different kinds of magic.

lines.speaker: riftkeeper
lines.text: Finish each level part to save its shards. Death loses only unsaved ones. In co-op, each player must collect world shards themselves.

lines.speaker: mentor_berserker
lines.text: Show me you can fight fiercely without losing control.

lines.speaker: mentor_berserker
lines.text: Move between attacks. Save heavy swings for clear openings.

lines.speaker: mentor_berserker
lines.text: The fight is over. Come speak to me.

lines.speaker: mentor_berserker
lines.text: You've learned the Berserker discipline. Take the exit and protect what matters.

lines.speaker: mentor_ninja
lines.text: Good positioning wins fights. Show me yours.

lines.speaker: mentor_ninja
lines.text: Leave attack warnings before they land. Strike from a clear angle, then move.

lines.speaker: mentor_ninja
lines.text: Well fought. Come speak to me.

lines.speaker: mentor_ninja
lines.text: You've learned the Ninja discipline. Take the exit. Keep finding openings.

lines.speaker: mentor_reaper
lines.text: Your scythe has reach. Use it without ignoring enemy attacks.

lines.speaker: mentor_reaper
lines.text: Fight near the edge of your reach. Strike when enemies commit to an attack.

lines.speaker: mentor_reaper
lines.text: The chamber is clear. Come speak to me.

lines.speaker: mentor_reaper
lines.text: You've learned the Reaper discipline. Take the exit. Balance power with patience.

lines.speaker: mentor_chronomancer
lines.text: Timing matters more than rushing. Show me you can use an opening.

lines.speaker: mentor_chronomancer
lines.text: Use enemy pauses to move or attack. Your time skills create more of those openings.

lines.speaker: mentor_chronomancer
lines.text: The trial is complete. Come speak to me.

lines.speaker: mentor_chronomancer
lines.text: You've learned the Chronomancer discipline. Take the exit and make each moment count.

lines.speaker: mentor_pirate
lines.text: Keep your footing when the fight gets messy. Show me.

lines.speaker: mentor_pirate
lines.text: Fire your pistol from a distance. Charge your saber when enemies get close.

lines.speaker: mentor_pirate
lines.text: Still standing. Come speak to me.

lines.speaker: mentor_pirate
lines.text: You've learned the Pirate discipline. Take the exit. Keep your footing and pick your shots.

lines.speaker: mentor_paladin
lines.text: Protect yourself without becoming careless. Show me you can hold your ground.

lines.speaker: mentor_paladin
lines.text: Watch enemy warnings. Leave room to dodge and use protection before a hit lands.

lines.speaker: mentor_paladin
lines.text: You made it. Come speak to me.

lines.speaker: mentor_paladin
lines.text: You've learned the Paladin discipline. Take the exit and use your strength to protect others.

lines.speaker: mentor_necromancer
lines.text: Fight with your summons. Don't let commanding them distract you from danger.

lines.speaker: mentor_necromancer
lines.text: Give summons room to fight. Dodge attacks aimed at you and use the openings they create.

lines.speaker: mentor_necromancer
lines.text: The trial is complete. Come speak to me.

lines.speaker: mentor_necromancer
lines.text: You've learned the Necromancer discipline. Take the exit. Command your allies carefully.

lines.speaker: mentor_pyromancer
lines.text: Fire is useful when you control where it goes. Clear this chamber and show me.

lines.speaker: mentor_pyromancer
lines.text: Keep moving between casts. Use your shield or blast when enemies get close.

lines.speaker: mentor_pyromancer
lines.text: The chamber is clear. Come finish your lesson.

lines.speaker: mentor_pyromancer
lines.text: You've earned the Pyromancer discipline. Take the exit. Keep your flame under control.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Martin sent you? Good. Let's get you to Sunspire.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Sunspire lies beyond the island cliffs. Repair this boat with a rudder, sailcloth and rope.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Fit what you find at my workbench. I can help if you prefer.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: The rudder fits. Now we can steer.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Good sailcloth. That will hold.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Strong rope. Just what we need.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Rudder: western wreck's raised stern. Sailcloth: eastern lookout. Rope: cave below that ridge; drain it before lifting the inside latch.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Avoid marked rocks and clear boarding enemies. Sheltered water halfway across lets you repair the hull and swap steering roles.

lines.speaker: otto
lines.text: Check the shore before departing. You may still have unfinished tasks.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: That wreck was my ship. Its bell should still be inside. Would you fetch it?

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: I stayed at the wheel. The others took the small boat. I never learned where they landed.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Found anything? No need to make it sound better than it is.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Together. Thank you for telling me honestly. Take this Rift Shard from our deck.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Some escaped. I needed that reminder. Take this Rift Shard, and stay safe at sea.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Watch the clear water beside each rock. That's your route through.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Straighten the crew's name board beside the wreck before the tide takes it. Then leave me alone.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: I heard you. I would rather see what you do next.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: Leave the bell on the beach if you want. Leave me in peace either way.

lines.speaker: hugh
lines.text: These halls hold dangerous knowledge. A locked door didn't keep the Legion out.

lines.speaker: hugh
lines.text: You helped our people. Keeping this door shut won't protect them now.

lines.speaker: hugh
lines.text: Demanding dangerous knowledge won't earn my trust.

lines.speaker: hugh
lines.text: The service workers know how to get past broken doors without my permission.

lines.speaker: hugh
lines.text: Move the loose pages onto the dry desk in the east records room, away from the broken window.

lines.speaker: hugh
lines.text: Follow the central aisle through the reading hall. The guardian beyond still attacks anyone who approaches.

lines.speaker: hugh
lines.text: The orb allows one clear question. Ask what you came to learn.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: Welcome to the restricted shelves. The Legion has made a mess of our rules.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: A shard is across that gap. Turn the first crank, cross the shelves, then turn the second crank on the far landing.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: The gold edges mark where the shelves will unfold. If you fall, use the lower shelves to get back and try again.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: The Legion wants our maps and spells. We should have shared this knowledge before they seized it.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: A senior scholar threw the training rifts from Sunspire to save them. Their scattered shards can restore the lessons inside.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: Activate one archive seal at a time. Defeat its guards and secure the stand before the gold marks fade. Failed attempts can be retried.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: Save the records, then collect the shard inside the archive seal.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: A young dragon is trapped on the western terraces. Follow the ledge beyond the empty displays.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: Get spare beams and dried meat from the lower supply ledge. Brace the cracked frame before turning the winch, then climb up and release the net.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: It ate part of the rulebook. The staff liked that.

lines.speaker: simon
lines.text: The dragon trusts you. Give it room and finish the reading halls together. The Beastkeeper can help afterward.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: Looking for Ellis? Follow his scratched arrows uphill. The Legion is searching for him too.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: The caves are uphill. Let me help you get there safely.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: The heater coil fell out beside the crossing. Fit it in the winch, then climb toward the cave. The western ridge shelters you from the wind.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: He arrived with research papers and little food. He was afraid someone had followed him.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: Wait behind the rock until the hanging cloth goes slack. Or take the sheltered ridge.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: West of the upper trail is an explorer’s camp. I can see his survey rig above it. Those broken ledges might still hold your weight.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: The crossing is down. This small healing pad has limited charge. The cave is buried under a snow shelf. Look for the anchor above it.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: Find Ellis. I'll keep the shelter ready for your return.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: The crossing is ready. Read the marker on the broad shelf above the cave. It points to the cornice anchor.

lines.speaker: heath
lines.text: West of the upper trail. Follow the broken ledges above the camp. The rig’s anchor is at the top.

lines.speaker: sunspire_orb
lines.text: You have reached me. One question, freely asked. No title is needed here.

lines.speaker: sunspire_orb
lines.text: Then take that moment. Fear does not make your purpose smaller.

lines.speaker: sunspire_orb
lines.text: A short speech leaves more room for the truth.

lines.speaker: sunspire_orb
lines.text: These souls were taken through the Hollow Gate. They remain trapped in the Abyssal Void while their bodies obey the King.

lines.speaker: sunspire_orb
lines.text: His soul anchors the Gate's control. Defeat him to break that control. While he lives, he can keep taking people.

lines.speaker: sunspire_orb
lines.text: Castle Duskmoor. Remember this vision: the shore, the narrow landing, then the climb beneath the western wall. This is his hidden home.

lines.speaker: sunspire_orb
lines.text: You know the way. Go help the people you came to save.

lines.speaker: sunspire_orb
lines.text: The path has been shown. What you do with it belongs to you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You crossed safely. Good. The climb to Sunspire starts here.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The eastern steps reach the middle ledge. The broken cargo lift is a shortcut if you want to repair it. Look for an old hydra shackle above.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'll watch the boat. Take care on the climb.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The Legion chained a hydra across the climb. It attacks because the chains hurt it—not because it serves them.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Free it before deciding it has to die.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Inspect the old shackle on the middle ledge. Break the new neck shackles while the hydra rests. It may leave once free.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You helped a creature that could have killed you. Remember that kindness when you reach the palace.

lines.speaker: dash
lines.text: This is my treasure claim. The stick makes it official. Probably.

lines.speaker: dash
lines.text: Help open the wreck cave and split the coins. Or beat my cliff race to keep them all.

lines.speaker: dash
lines.text: Brace the lower catch open, then turn the upper wheel. One person can do it.

lines.speaker: dash
lines.text: Touch flags 1, 2 and 3, then ring the cave bell within two minutes. Return here to retry.

lines.speaker: dash
lines.text: You earned those coins. That climb was worth watching.

lines.speaker: warden_shade
lines.text: The Legion is approaching Briar. The townspeople are doing what they can. Protect the supplies and help your neighbors prepare. Every person you help gives the town a better chance.

lines.speaker: warden_shade
lines.text: Free the canyon prisoners. Use cover when the Marksman aims.

lines.speaker: warden_shade
lines.text: Rescue the hidden prisoners. Their lift is the way out.

lines.speaker: warden_shade
lines.text: Find Ellis in the ice caves. Three officers guard the exit.

lines.speaker: warden_shade
lines.text: Shelter the workers, then stop the Legion's weapon line.

lines.speaker: warden_shade
lines.text: Repair the boat. Beyond the coast, a chained hydra needs your help.

lines.speaker: warden_shade
lines.text: Reach the knowledge orb. The palace guardian blocks your path.

lines.speaker: warden_shade
lines.text: Climb to the Hollow Gate. The King waits at the summit.
